title: network_try output
description: A design trial of a service for the organisation, through its own consumer identity.

output.description: Never sent since EKP 3.1: a trial never returns the service's answer.

charged.description: Always false: a trial is never charged.

would_be_charged.description: Whether a real call would be.

score.description: How well the output matched the expectation, in steps of 0.05; null when it couldn't be scored.

match.description: The score as a percentage match with the expected output; null when the trial has no score.

passed.description: Whether the score reached the threshold.

checks.description: Empty from EKP 3.6: a trial answers only whether it passed, its score and its match.

compiled.description: An expectation given in words, as the checks the network compiled from it.

error_code.description: How a trial that didn't succeed ended.
